mapper.sql:
SELECT a.amount_no, a.requested_amount, a.approved_amount, a.requested_at, a.approved_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.status, a.amount_comment, a.workcation_no,
e.emp_name,
ai.item_no, ai.item_type, ai.item_date, ai.item_approved, ai.item_description, ai.amount_no AS item_amount_no,
al.amount_no AS sponsor_amount_no, al.sponsor_name, al.amount AS sponsor_amount, al.payment_date, al.status AS sponsor_status, al.remark, al.item_no AS sponsor_item_no,
af.amountattachment_no, af.file_path, af.origin_name, af.change_name, af.updated_at AS file_updated_at, af.status AS file_status, af.amount_no AS file_amount_no FROM amount a LEFT JOIN workcation_info w ON a.workcation_no = w.workcation_no LEFT JOIN employee e ON w.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN amount_item ai ON a.amount_no = ai.amount_no LEFT JOIN amount_list al ON ai.item_no = al.item_no AND a.amount_no = al.amount_no LEFT JOIN amount_file af ON a.amount_no = af.amount_no AND af.status = 'Y'
mapper.select: WHERE a.workcation_no = #{workcationNo} ORDER BY a.amount_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE amount SET status = #{status}, approved_amount = #{approvedAmount}, amount_comment = #{amountComment}, approved_at = IF(#{status} = 'A', NOW(), approved_at), updated_at = NOW() WHERE amount_no = #{amountNo}
mapper.select: SELECT item_no FROM amount_item WHERE amount_no = #{amountNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'A' THEN a.approved_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalApproved, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM amount_list) as totalSponsor, IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN a.status = 'A' THEN a.approved_amount END), 0) as avgApproved, (SELECT IFNULL(AVG(amount), 0) FROM amount_list) as avgSponsor, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('R', 'H') THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT w.emp_no) as totalParticipants, COUNT(a.amount_no) as totalCount FROM amount a LEFT JOIN workcation_info w ON a.workcation_no = w.workcation_no

SELECT IFNULL(d.dep_title, '미지정') as deptName, SUM(a.approved_amount) as amount FROM amount a LEFT JOIN workcation_info w ON a.workcation_no = w.workcation_no LEFT JOIN employee e ON w.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN department d ON e.dep_id = d.dep_id WHERE a.status = 'A' GROUP BY d.dep_title

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(requested_at, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(DISTINCT w.emp_no) as participants FROM amount a LEFT JOIN workcation_info w ON a.workcation_no = w.workcation_no GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(requested_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
